Manish Malhotra Debuts at Paris Couture Week, Isha Ambani Attends

Designer Manish Malhotra made his debut at Paris Couture Week, presenting his collection. He paid tribute to his late mother during the show. Isha Ambani, Karan Johar, and Anna Wintour were among the attendees.
